title: Kavi model curriculum: people, original works, and textbook candidates
selection_basis: The order follows conceptual prerequisites, testability, and breadth of durable contribution. It is not a claim that one culture or person has objectively greater human worth or intelligence.
admission_rule: Every entry is catalog metadata only. No work may become training text until its exact edition, jurisdiction, rights, provenance, local extract fingerprint, lesson verifier, and held-out evaluation have passed review.

tracks.title: Generated foundations before authored works
tracks.purpose: Teach symbols, quantities, exact relations, and checks using generated lessons so early learning does not depend on a copied book.

entries.work: Generated lowercase glyph, digit, quantity, and arithmetic curriculum
entries.why_here: It gives Kavi exact labels and verifiers before it encounters ambiguous natural language.

tracks.title: Mathematical language, construction, and proof
tracks.purpose: Move from symbols and relations to definitions, constructions, proof structure, and counterexamples.

entries.why_here: A canonical progression from definitions and postulates to explicit propositions and proofs.

entries.work: On the Sphere and Cylinder; Method of Mechanical Theorems
entries.why_here: Connects construction, approximation, and argument about limits.

entries.work: The Compendious Book on Calculation by Completion and Balancing
entries.why_here: Introduces equation solving as a repeatable symbolic procedure.
Links geometric structure to algebraic representation.

entries.work: Elements of Algebra; Introductio in analysin infinitorum
entries.why_here: Builds flexible symbolic manipulation and functional thinking.

tracks.title: Logic, formal systems, and limits of proof
tracks.purpose: Teach claims, inference rules, models, counterexamples, and the boundaries of formal reasoning.

entries.why_here: Early explicit analysis of categories, propositions, and valid inference.

entries.work: An Investigation of the Laws of Thought
entries.why_here: Turns logical structure into operations that can be tested mechanically.
Adds quantification and explicit logical form beyond simple propositions.

entries.work: The Principles of Arithmetic, Presented by a New Method
entries.why_here: Separates assumptions, notation, and derivation for exact numerical reasoning.
Makes consistency, independence, and formal structure explicit learning targets.

entries.work: On Formally Undecidable Propositions of Principia Mathematica and Related Systems
entries.why_here: Prevents the curriculum from treating every well-formed question as mechanically decidable.

tracks.title: Measurement, experiment, and physical explanation
tracks.purpose: Teach the difference between observation, model, prediction, uncertainty, and a replicated result.

entries.why_here: A foundational example of controlled observation, explanatory models, and error correction.
Connects idealization, experiment, and mathematical description of motion.
Shows how a small set of laws can organize diverse measurable phenomena.
Pairs carefully described experiments with conceptual field-like reasoning.

entries.work: A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism
entries.why_here: Connects local relations, equations, and global physical behavior.
Teaches evidence aggregation, competing explanations, and slow cumulative change.
Adds careful measurement and theory building at the boundary of physics and chemistry.

tracks.title: Abstraction, uncertainty, computation, and control
tracks.purpose: Build the mathematical prerequisites for algorithms, information, optimization, and formal mathematical research.

entries.why_here: Develops structural number theory and precise proof practices.

entries.work: On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude
entries.why_here: Connects complex analysis, prime distribution, and the later benchmark question without assuming its solution.

entries.work: Contributions to the Founding of the Theory of Transfinite Numbers
entries.why_here: Introduces precise reasoning about infinity, size, and diagonal arguments.
Connects symmetry constraints to conserved structure, a useful pattern for model design and physics.

entries.work: On Computable Numbers, with an Application to the Entscheidungsproblem
entries.why_here: Defines a rigorous limit and model of mechanical computation.
Separates information, coding, noise, and channel limits.

entries.work: First Draft of a Report on the EDVAC
entries.why_here: Clarifies stored-program computation and the separation of data, procedure, and memory.

entries.work: Foundations of the Theory of Probability
entries.why_here: Provides the axioms needed to distinguish uncertain beliefs from exact logical claims.
Teaches decomposition of long tasks into value-bearing subproblems.

tracks.title: Learning, representation, causality, and efficient computation
tracks.purpose: Compare modern methods only after Kavi can represent language, evidence, and formal evaluation.

entries.why_here: Distinguishes correlation, intervention, and counterfactual explanation.
Offers comparison baselines for staged learning and representation formation.
Provides comparison baselines for learned internal representations.
Provides comparison baselines for constrained dynamics and perception.
Useful for implementation discipline and transparent small-model controls, not as a substitute for Kavi's original core tests.

tracks.title: Textbook reference shelf
tracks.purpose: Provide modern explanatory coverage after the original-work sequence; titles are references until their exact editions and terms are reviewed.

entries.why_here: A modern bridge from informal argument to proof practice.
Builds vectors, transformations, and numerical intuition needed for many model mechanisms.
Connects computation to rigorous definitions and proof.

entries.person: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, and Clifford Stein
entries.why_here: Supplies standard algorithms and complexity baselines for Kavi's own search and routing experiments.
A broad explanatory resource that remains quarantined because current title-specific terms require review before any training use.
